done_when: build/Tether.app has Contents/Frameworks/Sparkle.framework, SUFeedURL and SUPublicEDKey only in --release builds, passes a deep signature check, and CFBundleVersion is the number from the tag; a script test checks rc1 < rc2 < final and that --feed test and --feed prod give the two feed addresses
command: scripts/build-app.sh --release --feed test && codesign --verify --deep --strict build/Tether.app && plutil -extract SUPublicEDKey raw build/Tether.app/Contents/Info.plist && bash scripts/tests/build-version.test.sh
body: Signs nested code inside out (Sparkle's helpers first) with the same identity. Version numbers: today CFBundleVersion is git describe (e.g. 6132e30), which Sparkle can't order. --release sets CFBundleVersion to a number that only grows, from the tag: major*1000000 + minor*10000 + patch*100 + rc (rc1 = 1, rc2 = 2, final = 99), so v6.1.0-rc1 < v6.1.0-rc2 < v6.1.0; CFBundleShortVersionString stays the VERSION file. Feed address: --feed prod (default) bakes .../releases/download/appcast/appcast.xml into SUFeedURL; --feed test bakes appcast-test.xml, for rc tags only.
evidence: build-version.test.sh: 17 passed, 0 failed. --release --tag v6.1.0-rc1 (throwaway identity, random key): Contents/Frameworks/Sparkle.framework, SUFeedURL=.../appcast-test.xml, SUPublicEDKey set, CFBundleVersion=6010001, lipo x86_64 arm64, codesign --verify --deep --strict: valid on disk. Source build: no SUFeedURL, Sparkle embedded, signed Tether Signing.
